caption:
Stock market news | Tech Mahindra sets Nov 30 1:1 bonus record date

Tech Mahindra announced a 1:1 bonus issue, with the record date fixed on November 30. Shareholders who held shares on that date will receive one fully paid-up ₹5 bonus share for each share they own.

The stock rose 2.13% on Monday, adding to a 12.38% gain over the past three months, reflecting investor interest in the upcoming bonus.
